mapper.select: SELECT DATA_DATE,COUNTERPARTY_CODE,COUNTERPARTY_NAME,MA_ID,MA_TYPE,CSA_ID,ROUND(CSA_MTA_CNY,6) AS CSA_MTA_CNY,ROUND(CSA_TH_CNY,6) AS CSA_TH_CNY,ROUND(CSA_NICA_CNY,6) AS CSA_NICA_CNY,ROUND(C,6) AS C,ROUND(V,6) AS V,ROUND(ADDON_AGG,6) AS ADDON_AGG,ROUND(multiplier,6) AS multiplier,ROUND(PFE,6) AS PFE,ROUND(RC,6) AS RC,ROUND(COEFFICIENT_ALPHA,6) AS COEFFICIENT_ALPHA,ROUND(EAD,6) AS EAD,MODIFIER,UPDATE_TIME,id,SINGLE_MA_ID,COALESCE(T.MA_ID, T.SINGLE_MA_ID) AS NETTING_SET FROM TB_36_SACCR_EAD_DETAIL T

SELECT T.COUNTERPARTY_ID AS COUNTERPARTY_CODE, T.BACVA_SECTOR, CASE WHEN UPPER(T.RATING) IN ('BBB','A','AA','AAA') THEN 'IG' WHEN UPPER(T.RATING) NOT IN ('BBB','A','AA','AAA','UNRATED') AND T.RATING IS NOT NULL THEN 'HY' ELSE 'NR' END AS INVESTMENT_LEVEL FROM TB_17_COUNTERPARTY T
mapper.delete: delete from TB_36_BACVA_DEAL_DETAIL where DATA_DATE = #{dataDate,jdbcType=DATE} AND MODIFIER = #{user}
delete from TB_36_BACVA_NETTING_SET_DETAIL where DATA_DATE = #{dataDate,jdbcType=DATE} AND MODIFIER = #{user}
delete from TB_36_BACVA_COUNTERPARTY_DETAIL where DATA_DATE = #{dataDate,jdbcType=DATE} AND MODIFIER = #{user}
